name: MultiNLI
description: Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MultiNLI) corpus extends SNLI to cover multiple genres of written and spoken English. Contains 433K sentence pairs with entailment, contradiction, and neutral labels, spanning ten distinct genres of text. Includes a matched dev/test set (same genres as training) and mismatched set (different genres) to test generalization.
reputation: Standard large-scale NLI benchmark covering diverse genres; a key component of GLUE and SuperGLUE; drove BERT-era NLU research; human performance ~92%
notes: Introduced at NAACL 2018. Genres include fiction, telephone speech, government reports, travel guides, face-to-face discussions, and more. NLI component in GLUE benchmark. The mismatched evaluation tests cross-genre generalization. Now largely saturated by transformer models. Part of the RepEval shared task.
